lines.q: Welcome back, quiz friends! Grab a pen and keep score. Fifty questions, from easy to legend. If you get forty right, your memory is excellent. Let's go! Which animal is the tallest in the world?
lines.a: The giraffe! Its neck alone is about two metres long.

lines.q: Which is the largest mammal on Earth?
lines.a: The blue whale! Bigger than any dinosaur we know of.

lines.q: Now it gets a little harder. What is the capital of Portugal?
lines.a: Lisbon! One of the oldest cities in Western Europe.

lines.q: Who painted the famous Water Lilies?
lines.a: Claude Monet! He painted the pond in his own garden at Giverny. If you're enjoying this, subscribe and turn on the bell!

lines.q: Welcome to the hard round. Which is the smallest ocean in the world?
lines.a: The Arctic Ocean! Much of it is covered in ice.

lines.q: What is the capital of Morocco?
lines.a: Rabat! Not Casablanca, which is the biggest city. That one catches so many people.
